WITH 
cte_0 AS (  SELECT "orders".customer_id "orders__customer_id", timezone('UTC', date_trunc('month', "orders".ordered_at)::timestamptz) "orders__ordered_month", COUNT(DISTINCT "orders".order_id) "orders__orders" 
  FROM  comparison_orders  AS "orders"
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  ORDER BY  3  DESC),
cte_1 AS (  SELECT "orders".customer_id "orders__customer_id", timezone('UTC', date_trunc('month', "orders".ordered_at)::timestamptz) "orders__ordered_month", DATE_TRUNC('day', timezone('UTC', "orders".ordered_at::timestamptz)) "orders__ordered_at_day", COUNT(DISTINCT "orders".order_id) "orders__orders" 
  FROM  comparison_orders  AS "orders"
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  ORDER BY  3  ASC),
cte_2 AS (  SELECT "fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" "orders__customer_id", "fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" "orders__ordered_month", "fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_at_day" "orders__ordered_at_day", sum("q_0"."orders__orders") "orders__customer_month_orders" 
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "orders__customer_id" "orders__customer_id", "orders__ordered_month" "orders__ordered_month", "orders__ordered_at_day" "orders__ordered_at_day" 
  FROM  cte_1  AS "cte_1") AS "fk_aggregate_keys"
  LEFT JOIN  cte_0  AS "q_0" ON (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" = "q_0"."orders__customer_id" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" IS NULL) AND ("q_0"."orders__customer_id" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" = "q_0"."orders__ordered_month" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" IS NULL) AND ("q_0"."orders__ordered_month" IS NULL))))
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  ORDER BY  3  ASC),
cte_3 AS (  SELECT "fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_at_day" "orders__ordered_at_day", sum(CASE WHEN "q_0"."orders__customer_month_orders" > 10 THEN "q_1"."orders__orders" END) "orders__orders_from_customers_with_10plus_orders_in_month" 
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "orders__customer_id" "orders__customer_id", "orders__ordered_month" "orders__ordered_month", "orders__ordered_at_day" "orders__ordered_at_day" 
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "orders__customer_id" "orders__customer_id", "orders__ordered_month" "orders__ordered_month", "orders__ordered_at_day" "orders__ordered_at_day" 
  FROM  cte_2  AS "cte_2"
   UNION ALL 
  SELECT DISTINCT "orders__customer_id" "orders__customer_id", "orders__ordered_month" "orders__ordered_month", "orders__ordered_at_day" "orders__ordered_at_day" 
  FROM  cte_1  AS "cte_1") AS "fk_aggregate_keys_source") AS "fk_aggregate_keys"
  LEFT JOIN  cte_2  AS "q_0" ON (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" = "q_0"."orders__customer_id" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" IS NULL) AND ("q_0"."orders__customer_id" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" = "q_0"."orders__ordered_month" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" IS NULL) AND ("q_0"."orders__ordered_month" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_at_day" = "q_0"."orders__ordered_at_day" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_at_day" IS NULL) AND ("q_0"."orders__ordered_at_day" IS NULL))))
  LEFT JOIN  cte_1  AS "q_1" ON (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" = "q_1"."orders__customer_id" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__customer_id" IS NULL) AND ("q_1"."orders__customer_id" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" = "q_1"."orders__ordered_month" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_month" IS NULL) AND ("q_1"."orders__ordered_month" IS NULL)))) AND (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_at_day" = "q_1"."orders__ordered_at_day" OR (("fk_aggregate_keys"."orders__ordered_at_day" IS NULL) AND ("q_1"."orders__ordered_at_day" IS NULL))))
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY  1  ASC)
SELECT "fk_aggregate"."orders__ordered_at_day" "orders__ordered_at_day", "fk_aggregate"."orders__orders_from_customers_with_10plus_orders_in_month" "orders__orders_from_customers_with_10plus_orders_in_month" 
FROM  cte_3  AS "fk_aggregate"
ORDER BY  1  ASC
LIMIT 10000
